SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 13.2.2 Comprehension, part of Technology Suggested vocabulary mobile phone, call, battery, text, message, smar in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How are pictures/picture description important in a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 13.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creative and problem solving- A learner practices making connections as they predict what could be happening in the story.

Values:
Respect: Acceptance is enhanced as the learner appreciates others’ opinions during group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self -esteem) - A learner acquires an enhanced level of self-esteem as they use analytical skills to make predictions of a story.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies comprehension skills when reading texts in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.
